temporal_methods.window: Greedy one-to-one matching within +/- 1 UTC day(s); a date is used at most once per sensor and cell.
temporal_methods.monthly_cell: Presence of at least one qualified sensor cell-day in the UTC calendar month.

limitations: Sensor-only categories do not prove missed detections or false positives.
FIRMS positive detections do not establish complete orbital or cloud-free coverage.
VIIRS is a comparison sensor, not ground truth.
Acquisition timestamps do not provide full overpass geometry or observation-opportunity masks.
